viv: onboarding hit: sample-app CI started failing after switching from curl -> Python SDK. requests to /v1/run with no timeout used to succeed, now SDK requests time out or get retries. suspect param drift around timeout vs timeout_ms.

kyle: can you paste the exact calls?

viv: curl (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-001","input":"echo hello","timeout_ms":10000}'
```
Python SDK (used in sample-app):
```py
client.run(model='rwd-small-001', input='echo hello', timeout=10)
```
returns repeated 504s and retries.

maya: aha. SDK serializes timeout=10 as HTTP header X-Client-Timeout: 10 rather than body field, and the server expects timeout_ms in payload. generator mapping changed key name and location.

sam: so two issues: param renamed (timeout -> timeout_ms) and moved (header vs body). That explains why server falls back to default short timeout and triggers retries.

kyle: digging into generator templates: older SDKs used passthrough kwargs; new typed clients convert certain numeric args into headers for local cancellation semantics. The mapping rule matched "timeout" and treated it as client-side cancel header. We need to avoid moving fields into headers when the API expects them in body.

viv: this affected onboarding because snapshot tests hit time-sensitive operations and now flap. Also noticed auth: when server returns 401 during retry, SDK attempts automatic token refresh but doesn't replay the original body in the same shape (headers vs body mismatch), so the retry ends up missing timeout_ms entirely.

maya: oh no. so two layered parity bugs: serialization location + auth replay mismatch.

kyle: plan: 1) patch generator to only map timeout -> header when explicitly annotated in spec. 2) ensure auth refresh replay uses the raw original request body (not the post-processed dict). 3) add a regression test comparing curl vs SDK payloads for run endpoint. I'll open INF-3612.

devx-bot: Created issue INF-3612: "SDK generator mapping moved timeout into header; auth refresh replay drops body fields -> onboarding CI flakiness" assigned to kyle.

kyle: PR 748 opened: fixes mapping rule, preserves original request body for replay, and adds unit+integration tests. Also added a small runtime warning when SDK sees a header-mapped field that conflicts with body fields.

viv: thanks. any ETA for a patch release? Onboarding blocked for 3 customers.

kyle: cutting 0.10.0-hotfix with the fixes and tests. ETA ~20m, will post release notes and update sample-app to pin the hotfix.

sam: can we also add a sample-app CI smoke that runs a curl vs SDK parity check on key endpoints to catch regressions early?

maya: yes adding to devex checklist. Also writing a tiny doc: "SDK serialization gotchas" showing header vs body and auth replay behavior.

devx-bot: INF-3612 status -> in_progress, linked PR 748, release candidate 0.10.0-rc1.

kyle: released 0.10.0-hotfix. sample-app pinned and CI green after update. closing INF-3612 after one stable day.

viv: confirmed manual runs also match curl payloads now. thank you all :heart:
